definitions.gloss: one side; single side; one face
definitions.explanation: One side or face of a flat object, as opposed to both sides. Used for paper, discs, tape, and other flat items.

examples.japanese: {片面|かためん}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}する→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: To print on one side only.

examples.japanese: {片面|かためん}⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ポスター→ポスター：09598_posutaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}った→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: I stuck a poster on the wall with single-sided tape.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{片面|かためん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しか⟦{書|か}けない→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{両面|りょうめん}→両面：11366_ryoumen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}ける→書く：00477_kaku⟧もの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えて→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: You can only write on one side of this paper, so please switch to one that allows writing on both sides.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a modifier: {片面|かためん}⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧ (single-sided printing), {片面|かためん}⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧ (single-sided tape). The opposite is ⟦{両面|りょうめん}→両面：11366_ryoumen⟧ (both sides, double-sided).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片面|かためん}⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧ (single-sided printing)
- {片面|かためん}⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧ (single-sided tape)
- {片面|かためん}⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧ (single-sided copy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{両面|りょうめん}→両面：11366_ryoumen⟧: both sides, double-sided — the opposite
- ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧: surface, front side — specifically the front/top side
- ⟦{裏面|りめん}→裏面：18245_rimen⟧: back side, reverse — the back/underside
